summary: Chat 5 Atlasfin Bridge implemented as a bounded read-only bridge under prisma-html/extras/atlasfin/bridge/** and published in PR #540. It reuses the 418-element Atlasfin catalog and structured registries, preserves authority-domain separation, consumes optional worker candidate shards without fabricating missing data, exposes current Cobrar evidence as read-only reference, and leaves Materiality Catalog in STANDBY_USER_INVOKED_ONLY.

blockers.detail: PRISMA VISCORE1 Certification is red only at the final committed prisma-html/FILES_MANIFEST.json parity step because Chat 5 added five bridge files. Chat 5 ownership forbids writing that global manifest; the integration/composer lane must consume the generated manifest candidate.

findings: Atlasfin current manifest reports ATLAS_COMPLETE_27_PAGES with 418 catalog elements.
Structured Atlasfin registries currently expose 79 properties, 32 families, 32 presets, 8 recipes, 19 states, 16 variants, 8 adapters and 1 asset.
Current Cobrar exact-target evidence remains available and binding BND.ACT.PRIMARY.TABLET.POS.COBRAR.V1 is resolved; the bridge keeps Identity recipe IDs separate from Atlasfin recipe IDs.
The optional VISCORE Atlasfin status feed may be absent in-tree; bridge reports PENDING_NOT_PRESENT rather than synthesizing status.
Materiality Catalog was not inspected and the bridge contains a fail-closed guard against reading it automatically.
decisions: Reuse existing Atlasfin/VISCORE/GVAE foundations; do not rebuild Atlasfin, Identity Dictionary, RIFAT, Target Index or Visual Control.
Keep bridge read-only and contained to Chat 5-owned path.
Treat absent worker shards as PENDING_NOT_PRESENT and malformed/partial shards as INVALID.
Do not modify prisma-html/FILES_MANIFEST.json from Chat 5; hand that parity update to the integration/composer lane.
Do not merge PR #540 from Chat 5.
